name: @post/e2e-files
description: Files read-only e2e (T0308 required test): real Chromium drives the built web app through the read-only Files page — tree navigation, file preview, per-file commit history, raw download, raw diff links, the Scientific Context jump — and asserts the absence of mutation controls in both the DOM and the network traffic. The API is mocked at the network layer with the exact wire shapes cmd/api/fileshttp produces (the Go handler suite locks those shapes against a real guard).
